description: Leader election coordinator returns False on successful leader lease renewals, causing leader nodes to believe they lost leadership.
spec_notes: ElectionCoordinator.acquire_or_renew must return True when the active leader successfully extends its lease.

tests.test_leader_election.py:
from election_fsm import ElectionCoordinator
from cluster import ClusterNode


def test_initial_leader_acquisition():
    coord = ElectionCoordinator(lease_duration=10.0)
    n1 = ClusterNode("node_1", coord)
    assert n1.heartbeat(now=100.0) is True
    assert coord.get_current_leader(now=100.0) == "node_1"


def test_competing_node_rejected_during_active_lease():
    coord = ElectionCoordinator(lease_duration=10.0)
    n1 = ClusterNode("node_1", coord)
    n2 = ClusterNode("node_2", coord)
    n1.heartbeat(now=100.0)
    # n2 tries to take leadership at t=105 while n1 lease expires at 110
    assert n2.heartbeat(now=105.0) is False
    assert coord.get_current_leader(now=105.0) == "node_1"


def test_leader_lease_renewal():
    coord = ElectionCoordinator(lease_duration=10.0)
    n1 = ClusterNode("node_1", coord)
    n1.heartbeat(now=100.0)
    # n1 renews at t=105 (new expiration 115)
    assert n1.heartbeat(now=105.0) is True
    assert coord.get_current_leader(now=112.0) == "node_1"


def test_expired_lease_allows_new_leader():
    coord = ElectionCoordinator(lease_duration=5.0)
    n1 = ClusterNode("node_1", coord)
    n2 = ClusterNode("node_2", coord)
    n1.heartbeat(now=50.0)  # expires at 55.0
    # At t=60, n2 acquires leadership
    assert n2.heartbeat(now=60.0) is True
    assert coord.get_current_leader(now=60.0) == "node_2"
